dataset.name: Mayo never-smoker lung adenocarcinoma cohort (GSE87340)
dataset.description: Independent stage I lung adenocarcinoma cohort from never-smokers with paired tumor/normal bulk RNA-seq and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Twenty-seven patients with stage IA or IB lung adenocarcinoma and no smoking history contributed one primary tumor and one matched nonmalignant lung specimen. TRACE Explorer retains only the 27 primary-tumor profiles.
dataset.publication_citation: Sun et al. BMC Medical Genomics 2014

metadata.source_program: Mayo Clinic never-smoker lung adenocarcinoma cohort
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-provided vital status and time to last follow-up in years
metadata.endpoint_caveat: GEO labels the interval as time to last follow-up but does not state a more precise time origin. TRACE Explorer preserves the source interval and event coding and does not reinterpret it as TCGA-CDR OS.
metadata.sample_selection_note: GEO contains 27 tumor/normal pairs. Titles ending in A.RNA-seq are the adenocarcinoma specimens; B.RNA-seq and the single C.RNA-seq title are matched nonmalignant lung and are excluded before normalization.
metadata.overlap_note: This frozen Mayo Clinic never-smoker cohort is independent of TCGA-LUAD and of the other institutionally named LUAD releases registered in TRACE Explorer.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO count matrix in place. Direct source-matrix redistribution remains disabled under the conservative repository policy.

samples.sample_role: Resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma from a never-smoker

expression.label: GEO raw counts normalized as log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided gene symbols in the pinned GEO raw-expression matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The 22,558 non-empty source symbols are unique after case normalization; no implicit aggregation is applied.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer selects the 27 primary-tumor columns, computes library-size CPM across all 22,558 non-empty source rows and applies log2(CPM + 1). Matched nonmalignant lung columns are excluded before normalization.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Not specified beyond the source follow-up interval
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause as encoded by the GEO survstatus field
